title: Threat Intelligence Analyst
description: A deep, project-based roadmap for Threat Intelligence Analyst: Turn threat data into decisions with ATT&CK mapping, OSINT, adversary tracking, intelligence reports, PIRs, and stakeholder briefings.

tree.name: Foundations and Strategic Context of CTI
tree.description: Establish a robust understanding of Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI), its strategic value, the full intelligence cycle, and the critical frameworks that underpin effective threat analysis and decision-making.

resources.title: Introduction to Cyber Threat Intelligence (Recorded Future)
Understanding the Intelligence Cycle
What is Cyber Threat Intelligence? | CTI Explained (PRAMOD CYBER LAB)

children.name: Cybersecurity Fundamentals & Network Basics
children.description: Review foundational cybersecurity concepts, networking protocols (TCP/IP), operating system basics (Windows/Linux), and common security controls crucial for understanding threat context.

resources.title: CompTIA Security+ Certification Course
Networking Basics for Security Professionals

children.name: Introduction to CTI, Value & Role Definition
children.description: Define Cyber Threat Intelligence, articulate its critical value proposition across different organizational levels, distinguish it from raw data and information, and detail the day-to-day responsibilities of a Threat Intelligence Analyst.

resources.title: Cyber Threat Intelligence Explained: A Quick Guide for Beginners (Adam Goss)
The Threat Intelligence Analyst Role: A Day in the Life

children.name: The Intelligence Cycle & Requirements (PIRs)
children.description: Master the phases of the intelligence cycle (Planning & Direction, Collection, Processing & Exploitation, Analysis & Production, Dissemination, Feedback) and learn to define Priority Intelligence Requirements (PIRs) and Specific Information Requirements (SIRs).

resources.title: The Intelligence Cycle Explained in Detail
Defining Priority Intelligence Requirements (PIRs)

children.name: Intelligence Frameworks & Models
children.description: Learn key frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK (Enterprise, Mobile, ICS), the Cyber Kill Chain, the Diamond Model of Intrusion Analysis, VERIS, and the Unified Kill Chain to structure threat understanding and analysis.

resources.title: MITRE ATT&CK Framework
Lockheed Martin Cyber Kill Chain
Diamond Model of Intrusion Analysis
VERIS Framework for Incident Reporting

children.name: Global Threat Landscape & Adversary Types
children.description: Explore the current global cyber threat landscape, different types of cyber threats, common adversary categories (nation-state, cybercrime, hacktivism, insiders), their motivations, and capabilities.

resources.title: Understanding the Cyber Threat Landscape (ENISA)
APT Groups and Operations

children.name: Ethical and Legal Considerations in CTI
children.description: Understand the ethical boundaries, privacy concerns, data protection regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA), and legal implications when collecting, analyzing, and sharing threat intelligence, including appropriate disclosure practices.

resources.title: Ethics in Cyber Threat Intelligence (Recorded Future)
Legal Aspects of Threat Intelligence Sharing

tree.name: Core Threat Intelligence Analysis & Enrichment
tree.description: Develop practical skills for collecting, processing, enriching, and analyzing raw threat data to identify Indicators of Compromise (IoCs), Tactics, Techniques, and Procedures (TTPs), and adversary intent.

resources.title: 100% FREE Threat Intelligence & Governance Analyst Certification | CTIGA Full Guide #Certification (Chirag Mahto)
The Art of Cyber Intelligence Analysis (SANS GCTI Course Overview)

children.name: Advanced Open-Source Intelligence (OSINT) Collection
children.description: Master advanced techniques for gathering intelligence from publicly available sources including deep web searches, social media analysis, dark web monitoring, technical blogs, open databases, and specialized OSINT tools and frameworks.

resources.title: OSINT Framework
Dark Web and Surface Web OSINT Techniques
Leveraging Public Databases for Threat Intelligence (e.g., Shodan, Censys)

children.name: Diverse Threat Data Sources & Feeds
children.description: Identify and utilize various internal and external threat intelligence sources: commercial feeds, government/ISAC sharing, vulnerability databases, malware repositories, and security blogs/research.

resources.title: Top Threat Intelligence Feeds and Platforms
National Vulnerability Database (NVD)
MISP Threat Sharing Platform Overview

children.name: Indicator Analysis, Enrichment & Correlation
children.description: Analyze various types of IoCs (IPs, domains, hashes, file paths, registry keys, YARA rules) to understand their significance, context, and relationships. Learn to enrich IoCs using external data sources and correlate them across incidents.

resources.title: Understanding IoCs and Their Lifecycle
Online IoC Analysis Tools and Services (VirusTotal, AlienVault OTX)
IoC Enrichment with Open-Source Tools

children.name: TTP Mapping & Adversary Profiling
children.description: Map observed TTPs (Tactics, Techniques, Procedures) to frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK. Develop comprehensive adversary profiles, including their motivations, capabilities, infrastructure, and historical activities.

resources.title: Mapping to MITRE ATT&CK Techniques
How to Create an Adversary Profile (Mandiant)

children.name: Malware Triage & Analysis Fundamentals
children.description: Gain foundational knowledge of malware analysis concepts, types of malware (ransomware, trojans, worms), common delivery mechanisms, and perform basic static and dynamic analysis to extract IoCs and behavioral patterns.

resources.title: Introduction to Malware Analysis (SANS)
Basic Static and Dynamic Malware Analysis

children.name: Vulnerability Intelligence & Exploitation Concepts
children.description: Track and prioritize vulnerabilities (CVEs) relevant to your organization's assets. Understand common exploitation techniques and how vulnerabilities are leveraged by adversaries in the wild.

resources.title: Vulnerability Management Best Practices
Exploit Database (Exploit-DB)

children.name: Structured Analytical Techniques (SATs)
children.description: Apply structured analytical techniques like Analysis of Competing Hypotheses (ACH), Devil's Advocate, Brainstorming, and Key Assumptions Check to improve the rigor, reduce bias, and enhance the objectivity of intelligence assessments.

resources.title: Structured Analytic Techniques for Intelligence Analysis (Book by Richards Heuer)
Analysis of Competing Hypotheses (ACH) Explained

children.name: Cyber Attribution & Threat Group Tracking
children.description: Learn methodologies for attributing cyber attacks to specific threat actors or groups. Understand the challenges and nuances of attribution and how to track evolving adversary campaigns.

resources.title: The Challenges of Cyber Attribution
Tracking APT Groups: A Practical Guide

children.name: Threat Modeling Fundamentals
children.description: Apply threat modeling techniques (e.g., STRIDE, DREAD) to identify potential threats to systems and applications, helping prioritize intelligence collection and defensive efforts based on an organization's specific risk profile.

resources.title: Introduction to Threat Modeling
STRIDE Threat Model Explained

tree.name: Intelligence Production & Effective Dissemination
tree.description: Learn to produce clear, concise, and actionable intelligence reports tailored for diverse audiences, and effectively disseminate them using appropriate formats, standards, and communication channels, ensuring feedback loops are established.

resources.title: Threat Intelligence Reporting Best Practices (SANS)
STIX Documentation

children.name: Data Standardization & Sharing (STIX/TAXII)
children.description: Understand and utilize industry standards like STIX (Structured Threat Information eXpression) for structured data representation and TAXII (Trusted Automated eXchange of Intelligence Information) for automated data exchange, crucial for interoperability.

resources.title: STIX 2.x Primer
TAXII 2.x Deep Dive for Threat Intelligence Sharing

children.name: Threat Intelligence Platforms (TIPs) & Management Tools
children.description: Gain hands-on experience with Threat Intelligence Platforms like MISP, OpenCTI, and other relevant tools for ingesting, managing, enriching, correlating, and sharing threat data effectively.

resources.title: MISP Documentation & Tutorials
OpenCTI Platform Overview
Implementing a Threat Intelligence Platform: A Practical Guide

children.name: Intelligence Report Writing for Diverse Audiences
children.description: Develop skills in writing clear, concise, and actionable intelligence reports. Learn to tailor content and level of detail for different stakeholders (strategic for executives, operational for security management, tactical for analysts).

resources.title: How to Write Actionable Threat Intelligence Reports
Writing for Different Audiences in Cyber Security

children.name: Stakeholder Briefing & Executive Communication
children.description: Master the art of presenting complex threat intelligence findings to technical and non-technical audiences, including executive leadership. Focus on tailoring content, visualizations, and delivery for maximum impact and informed decision-making.

resources.title: Effective Communication for Cyber Professionals (Course)
Briefing Executive Leadership on Cyber Threats

children.name: Intelligence Feedback Loops & Evaluation
children.description: Implement mechanisms for gathering feedback on intelligence products to continuously improve relevance, accuracy, and utility. Understand how to measure the effectiveness and impact of disseminated intelligence.

resources.title: Establishing a Threat Intelligence Feedback Loop
Measuring the Impact of Cyber Threat Intelligence

tree.name: Advanced CTI Operations & Automation
tree.description: Explore advanced aspects of CTI operations, including seamless integration of intelligence into security operations, leveraging automation for efficiency, proactive threat hunting, and quantifying program effectiveness.

resources.title: Automating Threat Intelligence Workflows (Recorded Future)
Integrating CTI with SIEM and SOAR (Splunk)

children.name: Integration with SOC & Incident Response
children.description: Understand how threat intelligence feeds into and supports Security Operations Centers (SOC) and Incident Response (IR) teams, improving threat detection, prioritization, and response capabilities across the incident lifecycle.

resources.title: How Threat Intelligence Powers Your SOC
CTI in the Incident Response Lifecycle (NIST)

children.name: Automation & Scripting for CTI (Python)
children.description: Learn to automate common CTI tasks such as data collection, parsing, enrichment, correlation, and integration with security tools using scripting languages, primarily Python, including working with REST APIs.

resources.title: Python for Cyber Security: Threat Intelligence Automation (Course)
Using APIs for Threat Intelligence Collection and Orchestration

children.name: Threat Hunting & Proactive Defense
children.description: Leverage actionable threat intelligence to perform proactive threat hunting, identify hidden threats, discover suspicious activities, and develop preventative measures before incidents escalate.

resources.title: Threat Hunting with Cyber Threat Intelligence (CrowdStrike)
Developing Proactive Defense Strategies based on CTI

children.name: Cloud Threat Intelligence
children.description: Understand unique threat landscapes and attack vectors in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP). Learn to apply CTI principles to cloud security, identify cloud-specific IoCs and TTPs, and integrate cloud logs into intelligence pipelines.

resources.title: Cloud Threat Intelligence: An Introduction
AWS Cloud Security Best Practices

children.name: Measuring CTI Effectiveness & ROI
children.description: Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and metrics to assess the value, impact, and return on investment (ROI) of threat intelligence operations. Implement CTI program maturity models and continuous improvement processes.

resources.title: Measuring the ROI of Threat Intelligence (Forrester)
CTI Program Maturity Models (NIST CTI Guide)

tree.name: Portfolio Building and Career Readiness
tree.description: Consolidate your learning into tangible proof of skills through practical projects and compelling case studies. Prepare effectively for interviews and strategically position yourself for a successful career as a Threat Intelligence Analyst.

resources.title: Building a Strong Cyber Security Portfolio (SANS)
Top Threat Intelligence Interview Questions

children.name: Capstone Project: End-to-End Threat Intelligence Workflow
children.description: Execute a full threat intelligence project from start to finish: define PIRs for a simulated organization, collect OSINT and other data, perform detailed analysis, produce a finished intelligence report, and deliver a stakeholder briefing.

resources.title: Project Idea: Building a Simple Threat Feed Integrator with Python
Project Idea: Adversary Tracking & Profile Development for a recent campaign

children.name: Creating Impactful Case Studies & Technical Write-ups
children.description: Learn to document your projects, analytical work, and research as compelling case studies or detailed technical write-ups. Clearly articulate the problem, your methodology, key findings, and the actionable impact of your intelligence.

resources.title: How to Write a Technical Case Study for Your Portfolio
Showcasing Your CTI Skills on GitHub and LinkedIn

children.name: Interview Preparation & Strategic Job Search
children.description: Prepare for technical and behavioral interviews specific to CTI roles. Understand common job requirements, practice articulating your skills and project experience, and develop a strategic approach to the job search.

resources.title: Cracking the Cyber Threat Intelligence Interview (YouTube)
Resume & Cover Letter Tips for CTI Roles
